verdict.rationale: Devin's first-party API is documented for automating workflows and creating sessions programmatically, and Devin MCP adds scheduled runs via cron expressions, so Devin can be driven without its UI. There is no documented headless or non-interactive CLI mode and no CI pipeline integration; Auto-Fix iterating on CI failures responds to CI rather than running inside it. missing for 10: documented headless/non-interactive CLI invocation, explicit CI pipeline integration (e.g., running Devin as a CI step), hands-on or independent corroboration of headless automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
